summary: Russian forces conducted missile and drone strikes targeting civilian and military infrastructure, including a military exhibition in the Kyiv region that resulted in casualties. Ukrainian long-range drones successfully struck military-linked vessels and an oil platform in the Caspian Sea. Significant economic disruption is noted in the agricultural sector due to strikes on infrastructure and farmland.
key_points: Russian missiles struck a private sports complex near Kyiv during a military exhibition, causing casualties among military and civilian attendees (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31894).
Ukrainian SBU drones targeted an oil platform at the Filanovskoye field and two sanctioned vessels, Port Olya 2 and Begey, in the Caspian Sea (Source: @UkraineNow/82923).
Russian strikes in the Zaporizhzhia region destroyed over 1,850 hectares of crops and damaged agricultural infrastructure (Source: @UkraineNow/82919).
A Russian missile strike in Sloviansk resulted in 5 deaths and 9 injuries, damaging 10 houses and a Latvian consulate building (Source: @UkraineNow/82909).
The Allseeds company suspended operations in the Odesa region due to high security risks from Russian attacks (Source: @UkraineNow/82901).
Russian forces targeted fuel, energy, transport, and port infrastructure used by the Ukrainian Armed Forces (Source: @tass_agency/387027).
A drone strike on a Wildberries warehouse in Yekaterinburg caused a fire and resulted in one death (Source: @tass_agency/387036).
Ukrainian forces struck a military enterprise in Kirov, Russia (Source: @UkraineNow/82911).

The Dnepropetrovsk region has expanded its mandatory evacuation zone for children to include 10 additional villages in the Synelnyky district (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31896).
In the Odesa region, the agricultural company Allseeds suspended operations due to extreme risks to personnel and facilities (Source: @UkraineNow/82901).
A drone strike in Sumy resulted in two deaths and damage to a post office, warehouse, and vehicles (Source: @UkraineNow/82912).
In the Zaporizhzhia region, a drone attack caused a fire in a 900 sq. m retail facility and injured one man (Source: @UkraineNow/82912).
Ukrainian forces targeted the Filanovskoye oil platform and the vessels Port Olya 2 and Begey in the Caspian Sea (Source: @UkraineNow/82923).
Russian forces targeted fuel, energy, transport, and port infrastructure used by the Ukrainian Armed Forces (Source: @tass_agency/387027).
A drone strike on a Wildberries warehouse in Yekaterinburg caused a fire and resulted in one death (Source: @tass_agency/387036).
Russian artillery in the Zaporizhzhia region reportedly destroyed an outpost and over 30 Ukrainian soldiers (Source: @tass_agency/387026).
A Wildberries logistics complex in Yekaterinburg was targeted by drones, causing a fire (Source: @tass_agency/387008).
Russian forces launched ballistic missile threats from the Belgorod and Kursk regions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69382, @mon1tor_ua/69376).
Russian forces conducted strikes in Sloviansk using two aerial bombs, killing 5 people and injuring 9 (Source: @UkraineNow/82909).
Russian artillery targeted an outpost in the Zaporizhzhia region (Source: @tass_agency/387026).
Ukrainian air defense intercepted one X-59/69 missile and 127 Russian drones (Source: @UkraineNow/82912).
Reactive drones were observed moving along the border in the Sumy and Chernihiv regions (Source: @kpszsu/70073, @eRadarrua/102559).
Ukrainian drones targeted the Filanovskoye oil platform and the vessels Port Olya 2 and Begey in the Caspian Sea (Source: @UkraineNow/82923).
Russian forces targeted seven settlements in the Kherson region, causing 12 injuries and damage to residential buildings and vehicles (Source: @UkraineNow/82912).
Reactive drones were observed moving west toward Mykolaiv and Odesa from the Kherson border (Source: @kpszsu/70049).
Russian forces prepared missiles for a massive strike on Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/82910).

sections.threat_assessment: The threat of massive missile and drone strikes remains high, with intelligence suggesting Russian forces are preparing for new waves of attacks. The targeting of civilian infrastructure, such as the military exhibition in Kyiv and agricultural sites in Zaporizhzhia, indicates a continued focus on economic and social disruption. Ukrainian long-range capabilities are effectively targeting Russian-linked maritime assets in the Caspian Sea.
sections.regional_response: The Dnepropetrovsk region has expanded mandatory evacuation zones for children in response to ongoing strikes. The Ukrainian government is managing the humanitarian impact of strikes on civilian infrastructure and agricultural sectors. International interest is noted regarding the potential for joint Polish-Ukrainian production of Patriot missiles.
sections.intelligence_notes: The strike on the Kyiv military exhibition highlights vulnerabilities in security protocols for large-scale events involving military personnel and international partners. The suspension of operations by major exporters like Allseeds demonstrates the direct economic impact of kinetic strikes on the agricultural sector. The use of long-range drones against Caspian Sea assets shows an expansion of the operational theater.
